completion:
Verify the records and add all fixtures.
3. Correct any errors (missing info, inaccurate info, fuzzy text).
4. Correct the category of the fixtures (if incorrect).
5. Enter your corrections in the comments (or corrections) of a check.
6. When documents are processed, all corrections will appear in italics and corrected text will have stures through them.
7. **NOTE:** When entering errors/corrections feature, **DO NOT** use the automated floor plan area check tool.

It is important to input accurate builder accreditation records. If the original check sheet was recorded incorrectly, your edits must reflect the report to the issuer.

## Editing a Builder Accreditation Check

After the building has been inspected, there may be some needed edits in the inspection record.

Follow the procedure below to make changes to the records:

1. Navigate to My **Building Records** dashboard.
